text_block_list.name: Event Manager
text_block_list.text:
――The countdown begins! 10, 9, 8, 7, 6, 5,
4――!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
(―I should be running far away, but I 
can hear her breath.
I'm sure it's because……I 
remember it on the grass.)

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
(We don't mesh at all.
But there's one time when 
it fits perfectly. It's on the turf.)

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
――She's got perfect control of her pace.
She's 
probably keeping her initial momentum.
Me too……!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
…I'm sure she's right on top of you.
She's 
probably swelling up in the corner,
so… I need 
to make it bigger too!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Crap! Did I overexert myself?! …No,
it's not a 
problem. I know her. At this rate…!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
(It's true that we're bumpy. That's 
why we're seriously clashing, and each 
time…… we're firmly in sync.)

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
(That annoyed me,
irritated me…… I absolutely 
didn't want to lose!
No matter how much I denied 
it…… with words! We――)

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: She's my rival!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Wow…! They're in perfect sync! 
We can't see each other at all!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: …I see. So they're racing right now.

text_block_list.name: Event Manager
text_block_list.text:
――Now, soon! Two Santas are 
trying to reach the top……!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaah…!

text_block_list.name: Event Moderator
text_block_list.text:
Look! Santa has made it to the top,
and the 
entirety of Harron Tower is lit up!

text_block_list.name: Event Moderator
text_block_list.text:
Light radiates from the top and pours down
on us 
like a present!

text_block_list.name: Crowd
text_block_list.text:
Wow, that's amazing! It's 
so pretty! Thanks, Santa!

text_block_list.name: Event Manager
text_block_list.text:
U-Uuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuu
uuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuu
uuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuu!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: …! Scarlet!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Vodka!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Thank you both for your hard work.
You've done a 
wonderful job as an official ambassador.
They 
were very grateful to you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Brian, Laurel,
and I will help you clean up. You 
can rest here and enjoy the night view.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Huh? We'll help too!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Do I look inhuman enough to put you guys to
work 
for a great service?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
…I'd like to thank you too.
Thank you for making 
the event a lot more exciting.
We can have a 
nice chat once in a while.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
…………Umm… What do you mean……talk 
to each other? Haha……

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: …Sorry.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I said I'm sorry! I said it was 
lame, and made fun of you.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I hit her. I… I actually…

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
…It's fine.
It's not like you to be stubborn.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: But…

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I said something terrible.
I think… I felt the 
same way as you.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: So I'm sorry too. Let's end this. Okay?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: …No. I'll say it.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Even if this happens again,
I'll understand! I… 
I really don't like you!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Hey, what are you—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
But I don't want to lose because it pisses
me 
off. It's because you're here that I'm
stronger.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
To me,
you… make me want to win… I hate to admit 
it, but you're the person I want to be.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: …What about you? What do you think of me?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Aren't you an idiot?! N-No, I'm not!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Say it! …Say it.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
…It's the same. I think of you 
as my one and only rival.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
…Also! Let me just say this!
That outfit… It 
really suits you!!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: …! Hmph. You're cool, too…
